settings.heading:
Skincare stopped asking why.
We brought it back.
settings.text: Project Skin exists because the industry sold ritual instead of root cause — trends, influencers, and miracle claims over evidence. We sell literacy first, formulations second.
settings.image_alt: Project Skin philosophy — evidence-led care for Indian skin

settings.heading: Literacy first
settings.text: A customer who understands their skin never buys the wrong product again. Education is the product — formulation comes second.

settings.heading: Root cause over ritual
settings.text: Most products quiet symptoms temporarily. We ask why the concern exists — biology, climate, and lifestyle included.

settings.heading: Diagnose, then formulate
settings.text: Indian skincare stayed cosmetic for too long. We make it part of a health ecosystem: understand the problem before prescribing a product.

settings.heading: Every ingredient earns its place
settings.text: Clinical evidence. Efficacious concentration. Right delivery technology. Nothing for the label alone.

settings.heading: What we refuse to compromise
settings.text: Science over trends. Health over hype. A “Project” — because fixing skin is a systematic, evidence-led process, not a product promise.

settings.image_1_alt: Science-led skincare for Indian skin and climate
settings.card_1_heading: Skin is an organ — not a canvas
settings.card_1_text: What you apply does not stay on the surface. It penetrates dermal layers and enters your bloodstream. That is not a warning — it is the mechanism we build around. Skin is health, not decoration.
settings.card_2_heading: Engineered for Indian skin — not adapted
settings.card_2_text: Climate volatility, pollution, high UV, hard water, and lifestyle stress: global formulas were never built for this. We design from the ground up for Indian skin, climate, and daily life.
settings.image_2_alt: Calm, healthy skin — long-term biology over overnight claims

settings.heading: The problem
settings.text: Indian skincare became a cosmetic tradition — rituals, trends, influencers, and miracle claims instead of actual skin health.

settings.heading: The realisation
settings.text: Skin is the body’s largest organ. What you apply is absorbed, not just displayed — making this a health issue, not only an appearance one.

settings.heading: The gap
settings.text: Indian skin faces climate swing, pollution, UV, and lifestyle stressors that Europe / US / Korea formulas were never engineered to solve.

settings.heading: The beginning
settings.text: Five founders built Project Skin to bridge science, technology, and skincare — specifically for Indian skin, climate, and life.

settings.heading: The approach
settings.text: Diagnose first, formulate second. Every product starts from root causes — not surface symptoms or trending ingredients.

settings.heading: The vision
settings.text: Become India’s most trusted science-led skin-health ecosystem — decisions driven by data and transparency, not hype.

settings.heading: From frustration to a clearer standard
settings.text: A short arc: why Indian skincare needed a health ecosystem — and how Project Skin began.

settings.quote: We sell literacy first, formulations second — because trust should arrive before the sale.

settings.heading: Science first
settings.text: We follow the science that creates trends — not the trends themselves. Mechanism over marketing theatre.

settings.heading: Education before purchase
settings.text: We tell you exactly what is in a product, why it is there, and what it will do — literacy before the cart.

settings.heading: Long-term skin health
settings.text: Healthy skin is a biological goal. Success is measured over time — not overnight transformation claims.

settings.heading: Built to earn curiosity — then trust
settings.text: Purpose, precision, performance, integrity, and inclusivity. Skin has no gender, shade, or type that deserves less. Keep learning with us.

settings.heading:
See the signal.
Build the right routine.
settings.text: Technology that organizes skin context, explains product choices, and helps you follow through — so care gets clearer over time.

settings.heading: Signal over guesswork
settings.text: Visible skin cues and your context are organized into a clearer starting point for cosmetic care.

settings.heading: Mechanism, explained
settings.text: Every recommendation should show what an ingredient is there to do — and why it belongs in your routine.

settings.heading: Learn from consistency
settings.text: Routines and check-ins create usable signal, so the next decision is better informed than the last.

settings.heading: Clarity before another product.
settings.text: We built this layer so you can understand the concern, the mechanism, and the next step — without miracle timelines or ingredient theatre.

settings.image_1_alt: Guided skin scan reviewed with a specialist
settings.card_1_text: Explore the system to turn scattered concerns into an explainable path: what you see, why a product fits, and how to stay consistent.
settings.card_2_heading: Built to learn with your routine
settings.card_2_text: Recommendations matter more when adherence and check-ins create a usable signal — so the next decision is better informed.
settings.image_2_alt: Daily routine guided by Project Skin

settings.heading: Observe
settings.text: A guided image and concern check-in organize visible skin signals into a useful starting point.

settings.heading: Add context
settings.text: Climate, sensitivities, current products and routine history help explain what the image alone cannot.

settings.heading: Match
settings.text: Products are compared by concern, mechanism, formula role and potential routine conflicts.

settings.heading: Review
settings.text: Routine tracking and repeat check-ins create a clearer basis for continuing, changing or escalating care.

settings.heading: Four connected decisions
settings.text: Each layer adds context. Together they turn a one-time recommendation into a more useful skincare system.

settings.heading: A living profile of your skin context
settings.text: A guided scan organizes visible concerns alongside the context you provide. It creates a reusable cosmetic skincare baseline; it does not replace medical diagnosis.
settings.feature_1: Organizes visible acne, pigmentation, texture and barrier cues
settings.feature_2: Adds climate, routine and lifestyle context
settings.feature_3: Creates a consistent baseline for future check-ins

settings.heading: Recommendations with a reason
settings.text: Products are matched to the concern, active mechanism and routine role. Every recommendation should explain what it does and why it belongs.
settings.feature_3: Routine conflicts and unnecessary duplication reduced

settings.heading: A routine you can actually follow
settings.text: Track completed steps, keep product order clear, and build enough consistency to interpret a later skin check-in with better context.

settings.heading: Review what changed
settings.text: Regular check-ins compare the current state with the original baseline so the routine can be reviewed with better context.
settings.feature_2: Routine consistency viewed alongside skin signals
settings.feature_3: Escalation to dermatologist consultation when needed

settings.heading: From signal to smarter routine
settings.text: Project Skin connects analysis, product matching and daily adherence so recommendations can become more relevant over time.

settings.quote: Technology should not sell another trend — it should make the next skincare decision more honest, explainable, and useful.

settings.heading: Guidance, not diagnosis
settings.text: Visible signals help organize cosmetic concerns; clinical symptoms need a dermatologist.

settings.heading: Consent and restraint
settings.text: Collect only what is needed for the experience and make the purpose of that information clear.

settings.heading: A route to human review
settings.text: When concerns fall outside cosmetic guidance, the next step is qualified clinical care.

settings.heading: Useful guidance. Clear limits.
settings.text: Project Skin technology is designed to improve cosmetic skincare decisions. It does not diagnose disease or replace qualified medical care.

settings.heading: Monsoon
settings.text: Humidity does not cancel acne biology.

settings.heading: Festive
settings.text: Celebration skin still needs biology.

settings.heading: Winter
settings.text: Dryness is often a barrier story.

settings.heading: Why percentage belongs on the label
settings.text: Name the dose. Cite the mechanism.

settings.heading: Your moisturiser isn’t failing you
settings.text: When cream fails, start with the lipid layer.

settings.heading: Breakouts aren’t a cleanliness problem
settings.text: Congestion, oil, and barrier stress — diagnosed first.

settings.heading: Education on a calendar.
settings.text: Seasonal climate, ingredient deep dives, and concern literacy — not sale banners.

settings.heading: Science first
settings.text: Clinical evidence guides every formulation decision — at every step of the process.

settings.heading: Efficacious doses
settings.text: We don’t add niacinamide for the list. We deliver concentrations where peer-reviewed studies show visible results.

settings.heading: Barrier-first thinking
settings.text: Treatment should not cost you your barrier. Repair and active care are designed to work together.

settings.heading: Engineered for Indian skin
settings.text: Climate range, pollution load, and biology — accounted for from the start, not bolted onto a global formula.

settings.heading: Actives + technology
settings.text: Right actives, right delivery, real results — ingredients and technology chosen to work together, not independently.

settings.heading: Root-cause formulas
settings.text: Products address the underlying cause of a concern — not the ingredient of the month.

settings.heading: Right actives. Right technology. Real results.
settings.text: Every line is built to solve a diagnosed concern — with honesty about what is in it, why it is there, and what it will do.
